customer: Caller politely explained she's relocating to Virginia for a new job and wanted to know what to bring to her upcoming appraisal appointment for her coupe.
agent: Customer asked what to bring to her appraisal appointment; walked her through "What to bring to your appraisal appointment": a valid photo ID for every owner on the title, current registration, all keys and remotes, the title if she has it, and odometer statement form NW-ODO-1, which can also be filled in at the store. Advised that if she still has a loan, she should bring her payoff letter instead of the title, and pointed her to "Getting a payoff letter." Mentioned that if any owner can't attend, she should see "When more than one person owns the car." Let her know to plan for about an hour.
